naming: <species>_<shape>_<anim>; every animation exists in every shape with the same frame size, frame count and fps

furKeys.note: Cat fur 1–3 of the menu ramps. These hexes equal the menu key colors, so the menu recolor shader covers both sheets

sprites.name: Draw pose · dozing off
sprites.note: Nods off where it stands: eyes shut, ears soft, Zs drift up

sprites.name: Draw pose · puzzled
sprites.note: Paw on the chin, head tilts, a question mark bobs: who won?

sprites.name: Aim right · paws roll the wheel
sprites.note: 40×32, full profile toward the pointer, eyes squeezed, sweat drops. Arms reach straight ahead; both paws rest flat on the near face of the rim: frames 0–2 slide them along it, 3 pulls them back. Place at (50,52) left-hand, flipped at (126,52) right-hand

sprites.name: Aim left · paws roll the wheel
sprites.note: Same stroke reversed

sprites.name: Aimer idle
sprites.note: Three-quarter view, paws off the wheel. Switch to cat_aim_* the moment a rotate button is held

sprites.name: Fire · pulls the lever toward itself
sprites.note: Faces the pointer. Left-hand layout flipped at (124,52), right-hand unflipped at (52,52). Synced with fire_lever 0,1,2,0

sprites.name: Firer idle
sprites.note: Same spot as cat_pull

sprites.name: Fire timer running out · aimer
sprites.note: Same as the aim cycle with wide eyes. Play at double speed

sprites.name: Fire timer running out · firer
sprites.note: Turns face to face with the player and taps the glass: left paw with the head leaning right, rest, right paw with the head leaning left, rest. The raised paw leaves its resting spot empty; no back feet show. Toe beans and pad show on the tapping paw, impact ticks on the outer side. Front view, never flipped

sprites.name: Knocked out · aimer (launcher)
sprites.note: 40×32, same spot as the aim pose. Bonk · squash, then cat_ko_jump takes over

sprites.name: Knocked out · firer (launcher)
sprites.note: 40×32, same spot as the fire pose. Bonk · squash. Faces right; flip for the left-hand layout

sprites.name: Knocked out · jump onto the ring
sprites.note: 40×32. Crouch · airborne. Arcs from either launcher spot onto the cracked pointer ring. Same for both roles

sprites.name: Knocked out · tapping the dog
sprites.note: 40×40, standing on all fours on the cracked ring at mechanism (99,71), facing the dog. Near front paw up · tap. Loop. Mirror with the dog when the dog sits left of the ring

sprites.name: Knocked by ceiling · as aimer
sprites.note: 48×44. Hit, squash, fall on back, dizzy. Play 0–4, loop 3–4

sprites.name: Knocked by ceiling · as firer
sprites.note: 48×44. Hit, squash, fall sideways, dizzy. Play 0–4, loop 3–4

sprites.name: Expressions
sprites.note: Neutral · Happy · Focused · Surprised · Sad · Panic
